$comment: Ratchet baseline for `npm run typecheck` (scripts/typecheck.mjs). Read that
script before editing this file: it is compared as an exact multiset of
(file, code, message), so it must be shrunk in the same commit that fixes an
entry, or `npm run typecheck` fails. Production src/ sources only - test
files and config files are never baselined.
`diagnostics` is generated from tsc 5.9.3's own output, never written by
hand; see 'Regenerating the baseline' in scripts/typecheck.mjs for the recipe
and for how to check a regeneration. tsconfig.json as committed by issue #39.
All production errors resolved. This file is kept (empty) so the gate still
runs and fails on any new regression.
